tools.name: roadflow_new
tools.description: Create an ephemeral in-memory roadflow workspace (default). Optional seed JSON and/or markup. No cloud id until create_shared.

tools.name: roadflow_status
tools.description: Return mode, ids, URLs, and road/step counts for the current MCP session workspace.

tools.name: roadflow_get
tools.description: Return the current workspace as JSON and/or markup.

tools.name: roadflow_apply_json
tools.description: Replace workspace state with normalized JSON (serializeState shape). In shared edit mode, saves to the cloud automatically.

tools.name: roadflow_apply_markup
tools.description: Replace roads via friendly markup (same as the editor panel). Shared edit mode auto-saves.

tools.name: roadflow_open_shared
tools.description: Load a cloud map by edit or view id into this session. View links are read-only.

tools.name: roadflow_create_shared
tools.description: Persist the current workspace to the cloud (permanent share). Returns editUrl (play/edit/share further) and viewUrl (visual canvas, read-only). Prefer viewUrl when the user only needs to see the map.

tools.name: roadflow_export_json
tools.description: Export the current workspace as JSON (serializeState).

tools.name: roadflow_export_markup
tools.description: Export the current workspace as friendly markup.

tools.name: roadflow_export_csv
tools.description: Export steps as CSV (road, goal, lane, step, notes, type, status, position, date).

tools.name: roadflow_list_versions
tools.description: List shared-map version checkpoints (newest first). Relative indexes: -1 = newest. Requires a shared edit workspace (not view-only).

tools.name: roadflow_get_version
tools.description: Load one shared-map version by relative index (e.g. -1 newest, -2 previous). Returns JSON state. Does not change the live map or workspace unless load=true.

tools.name: roadflow_discard
tools.description: Clear the in-memory workspace for this MCP session (does not delete cloud maps).

tools.name: artifacts_new
tools.description: Create an ephemeral in-memory Artifacts graph workspace. Optional seed JSON (serializeState shape: nodes + labels). No cloud id until artifacts_create_shared.

tools.name: artifacts_status
tools.description: Return mode, ids, /artifacts/?id= URLs, and node/label counts.

tools.name: artifacts_get
tools.description: Return the current Artifacts workspace as JSON.

tools.name: artifacts_apply_json
tools.description: Replace (or merge) the Artifacts graph with normalized JSON. Shared edit mode auto-saves to the cloud.

tools.name: artifacts_open_shared
tools.description: Load a cloud Artifacts graph by edit or view id. View links are read-only.

tools.name: artifacts_create_shared
tools.description: Persist the current Artifacts workspace to the cloud. Returns editUrl and viewUrl under /artifacts/.

tools.name: artifacts_export_json
tools.description: Export the current Artifacts workspace as JSON (serializeState).

tools.name: artifacts_list_versions
tools.description: List shared Artifacts version checkpoints (newest first). Requires a shared edit workspace.

tools.name: artifacts_get_version
tools.description: Load one shared Artifacts version by relative index (-1 newest). Optional load=true replaces the MCP workspace (does not save).

tools.name: artifacts_discard
tools.description: Clear the in-memory Artifacts workspace for this MCP session (does not delete cloud graphs or the Plans workspace).

tools.name: model_new
tools.description: Create a Model project in MySQL (parameter register). Allocates a view id (mv-…) when omitted and returns viewUrl. Optional seed: title, calendar, streams, axes, phases, parameterSets, chains, parameters, observations, edges. Does not persist CALC outputs or FORMULA edges. Binds this MCP session. UI

tools.name: model_open
tools.description: Bind this MCP session to an existing Model project (edit or view id). View ids are read-only.

tools.name: model_status
tools.description: Counts, rev, and /model/?id= URLs for the bound project (or pass id).

tools.name: model_get
tools.description: Hydrate records from MySQL. include=summary (default counts), dictionaries, parameters, observations, edges, or all. Prefer model_upsert_observation to change one fact — do not treat this as a blob to rewrite.

tools.name: model_discard
tools.description: Unbind the Model project from this MCP session. Does not delete MySQL rows.

tools.name: model_patch_project
tools.description: Update title, calendar, viewId, streams, axes, phases, parameterSets, and/or chains. Send If-Match via rev. Replaces each provided dictionary in full.

tools.name: model_list_parameters
tools.description: List parameter catalog rows. Optional filters: streamId, role, layer, primaryOwner.

tools.name: model_get_parameter
tools.description: One catalog row plus its observations (facts).

tools.name: model_upsert_parameter
tools.description: Create or patch one parameter definition (not observations). Pass rev for If-Match on update.

tools.name: model_upsert_parameters
tools.description: Create or patch many catalog rows (cap 400). Same body shape as model_upsert_parameter. continueOnError returns per-row errors; otherwise one transaction.

tools.name: model_delete_parameter
tools.description: Delete a parameter and its observations (cascade).

tools.name: model_list_observations
tools.description: List facts. Filter by parameterId, setId, evidenceStatus. Sets are a column (Base/Downside/Upside), not an axis.

tools.name: model_upsert_observation
tools.description: Create or replace one fact (parameterId + scope + setId). Example: Base P2 facility MW. Do not write CALC-computed values; only IN facts or CALC overrides (valueOverride). Pass rev for If-Match.

tools.name: model_upsert_observations
tools.description: Create or replace many facts (cap 400). Same body shape as model_upsert_observation. Rejects CALC outputs unless valueOverride. continueOnError returns per-row errors; otherwise one transaction.

tools.name: model_delete_observation
tools.description: Delete one fact by parameterId + scope/scopeKey + setId.

tools.name: model_list_edges
tools.description: Manual lineage edges only (SOURCE/FLOW/INTERFACE). FORMULA edges are derived from formulas on load — not stored.

tools.name: model_upsert_edge
tools.description: Create or patch a manual SOURCE, FLOW, or INTERFACE edge. FORMULA is rejected.

tools.name: model_delete_edge
tools.description: Delete a manual edge by edgeId.

tools.name: model_evaluate
tools.description: Read-only computeModel. Does not write MySQL. View ids allowed. Default period is calendar start (not today). periodId and range* are mutually exclusive. Cell cap 2000.

tools.name: model_list_dictionaries
tools.description: Streams, axes (members), phases, parameter sets, chains, and calendar. Period members may be derived from calendar.
